release.content: pubkit 0.40.0 was released on 2026-11-15 from commit 8475143eeef3ef7f51587a2434891cb162121128 with these changes.

rows: Rust's fuzz job runs each target for 5 s in the merge queue and on a push (fuzz-seconds, was 60 s), after replaying fuzz/regressions/, so a merge waits about a minute for it as for the other jobs; the nightly still fuzzes each for 900 s

job-tested uses an earlier run's tests only while that run's coverage artifacts are there: a run whose artifacts had expired and been deleted counted as having none expired, so main's sonar read no coverage and failed (pubsec, after a release PR merged a day after its run)

release.scope: the published release v0.40.0 of pubkit
